title: Constitution-making negotiations continue
detail: Political actors debated representation formulas, center-province powers, and institutional design while attempting to stabilize Pakistan's post-partition constitutional order.

title: Pakistan's first constitution comes into force
detail: Pakistan became an Islamic Republic under a new parliamentary constitution, formally replacing earlier transitional legal arrangements.

title: Representation and autonomy disputes persist in East Pakistan
detail: Despite constitutional transition, public and political dissatisfaction in East Pakistan continued around parity logic, provincial authority, and equitable participation in state power.

title: Constitutional fragility gives way to deeper crisis
detail: The unresolved tensions of the constitutional period contributed to institutional breakdown and opened the path toward military intervention and renewed constitutional conflict.
